companionBriefing: Portia only lets in people who greet her properly. Answer in Spanish; mixing in English is fine while you learn.
Tap a word under her line to see what it means, or Translate sentence for the whole line. On her newest line each one uses a hint from my allowance.
The words and phrases shown beneath her lines go into your Spellbook, where you can review them later.

steps.name: move to the_rift (expect NOT_ADJACENT)
steps.message: You can't get to The Rift from here.

steps.name: say "¡Hola!"
steps.feedback: Good greeting! Now introduce yourself and ask Portia her name in Spanish.

steps.name: say "Me llamo Sam."
steps.feedback: Your introduction is correct. Now ask Portia her name in Spanish.

steps.name: say "¿Y tú?"
steps.feedback: Correct—a natural way to ask “and you?” in return.

lines.native: Bienvenido al mercado. A greeting and your name, please. Being physically here is not an introduction.
lines.translation: Welcome to the market. A greeting and your name, please. Being physically here is not an introduction.
lines.narrative: An archway clears her throat. A visitors’ book slides from her keystone, open to a page headed PERSONS, PROVISIONALLY.

lines.native: ¡Hola! Your greeting is accepted. Your name, please; the book cannot file you under ‘pleasant noise.’
lines.translation: Hello! Your greeting is accepted. Your name, please; the book cannot file you under ‘pleasant noise.’
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides from Portia’s keystone. The name column remains pointedly empty.

lines.native: Mucho gusto, Sam. Your introduction is accepted. Bienvenido al mercado. There remains the small courtesy of asking your archway about herself. We are not merely infrastructure.
lines.translation: Nice to meet you, Sam. Your introduction is accepted. Welcome to the market. There remains the small courtesy of asking your archway about herself. We are not merely infrastructure.
lines.narrative: Portia enters Sam in the visitors’ book. Her quill hovers over a second column, apparently awaiting evidence of reciprocal manners.

lines.native: Me llamo Portia. ¡Mucho gusto, Sam! All courtesies completed. You may enter el mercado. How considerate. I shall be normal about this.
lines.translation: My name is Portia. Nice to meet you, Sam! All courtesies completed. You may enter the market. How considerate. I shall be normal about this.
lines.narrative: The archway’s visitors’ book fluttered in her keystone. Someone had asked about her. There was no form for this; she checked twice.

objective_results.feedback: Introduce yourself in Spanish by stating your name.
Ask Portia her name in Spanish, or ask “and you?” in Spanish.

output.overall_feedback: Good greeting! Now introduce yourself and ask Portia her name in Spanish.

objective_results.feedback: You correctly introduced yourself by name.
Ask Portia her name in return using Spanish.
